peers.name: NIPPON L I A M LTD

bull_bear.body:
- Interim dividend of ₹2.50 per share declared.
- Cash & cash equivalents of ₹971.45 Cr as on 30th June'26, defined by the deck as including bank balances, fixed deposits, government bonds and MF investments, and excluding money held in trust (ECS, NPS and stamp-duty collection accounts and unpaid dividend account).
- Return on Net-Worth of 36.8%, defined as annualised PAT over average equity for the quarter.
- Inorganic build-out of the non-MF stack over time: majority stake in Fintuple Technologies (2022), majority stake in Think360 AI (2023), and acquisition of the KRA business of NSE (2025 milestone block).
- Small strategic equity outlays for ecosystem positioning: "₹1 Cr. equity participation in Sahamati (SRO-AA)" by CAMS finserv, alongside a Board Observer role.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- "India's largest registrar and transfer agent (RTA) of mutual funds with an aggregate market share of 67.2%" (market share basis Q1 FY'27, on quarterly AAuM, excluding domestic fund-of-fund).
- Stickiness of the core book: services 9 of the 15 largest MFs, with "over 23.3 years average relationship with 10 largest MF clients."
- Positioned as embedded infrastructure rather than a vendor — CAMS is "involved through the life cycle of an account from account creation to processing transactions and redemption," spanning transfer agency, distributor services, investor services, risk management and compliance.
- Physical moat alongside the digital one: a "Pan-India physical network comprising 285+ service centers spread over 25 states and 5 union territories."
- Adjacent franchises each claim a top-two position: CAMS KRA is the "second-largest KYC Registration Agency" with 20% market share; CAMS is "#2 in eNPS onboarding"; CAMS for Alternatives is described as "the largest platform & service partner for alternatives."
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Regulatory pricing] CAMS KRA revenue declined 2.6% Y-o-Y "despite a market wide recommended rate revision of ~29%" — the deck does not state the direction of that revision, only its magnitude.
- [JV] MF Central Technologies Limited is a 50% joint venture (formed with KFin Technologies for MFCentral); the consolidated accounts carry a share of loss from the JV.
- [Group structure] Think360 AI, Inc (USA) is marked "Under Liquidation" in the corporate-structure chart; Think Analytics India Pvt Limited is held 55% with non-controlling interest eliminated in reported profits alongside Fintuple.
- [Ownership] The shareholding pattern shows FPIs 44.88%, Others 31.56%, MFs 15.72%, Insurance Cos 6.81% and AIF 1.01%, with no promoter category disclosed; the stock-data table reports Free Float of 19,778.19 Cr equal to the stated Market Capitalisation of 19,778.19 Cr.
- [Client concentration by counterparty] Bharti AXA Life Insurance "became third insurer to bring their entire policyholder base to Bima Central", and Personal Finance Manager is live with "one of the largest PSU Banks" — named-client dependencies are disclosed only descriptively.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions CAMS as a "technology-driven financial infrastructure and services provider" anchored on its dominant mutual-fund registrar-and-transfer-agent franchise (67.2% aggregate market share) that is deliberately diversifying into a stack of adjacent BFSI platforms — payments, alternatives, KYC, insurance repository, account aggregation, pension and AI.
